name: const unsafe fn offset_from_unsigned (self , subtracted : NonNull < T >) -> usize where T : Sized ,
rule: For `offset_from_unsigned(self, subtracted)` to be safe, the distance between the pointers in bytes must be an exact multiple of `size_of::<T>()`.
